1、

set serveroutput on;

--pkg头部定义的公有变量

--@testPoint pkg头部定义的公有变量做打开游标的投影列，cursor为pkg定义,强类型游标变量

drop package if exists pkg_b16687_005;

drop function if exists func_b16687_005;

drop table if exists tb_sit_b16687_005;



create table tb_sit_b16687_005(c1 char(10), c2 char(10));

insert into tb_sit_b16687_005 values(1,1);

insert into tb_sit_b16687_005 values(2,2);

commit;



create or replace package pkg_b16687_005 as 

n1 clob := 'testsuccess';

END pkg_b16687_005;

/



declare

  cursor cur_01 is select pkg_b16687_005.n1,c2 from tb_sit_b16687_005 order by 1;

  type record is record (c1 varchar(2000),c2 varchar(20));

  rec record;

begin

  open cur_01;

  fetch cur_01 into rec;

  dbms_output.put_line('[预期 1 1 ] ' || rec.c1 ||' '||rec.c2);

  fetch cur_01 into rec;

  dbms_output.put_line('[预期 1 2 ] ' || rec.c1 ||' '||rec.c2);

  close cur_01;

end;

/

2、

set serveroutput on;

drop package if exists pkg_b16687_005;

drop function if exists func_b16687_005;

drop table if exists tb_sit_b16687_005;



create table tb_sit_b16687_005(c1 char(10), c2 char(10));

insert into tb_sit_b16687_005 values(1,1);

insert into tb_sit_b16687_005 values(2,2);

commit;



drop package pkg_b16687_005;

--@testPoint pkg头部定义的公有变量做打开游标的投影列，cursor为pkg定义,弱类型游标变量

create or replace package pkg_b16687_005 as 

n1 clob := 'testsuccess';

END pkg_b16687_005;

/



declare

  type cursor is ref cursor;

  cur cursor;

  type record is record (

    c1 varchar(32000),

c2 varchar(20)

  );

  rec record;

begin

  open cur for select pkg_b16687_005.n1,c2 from tb_sit_b16687_005 order by 1;

  fetch cur into rec;

  dbms_output.put_line('[预期 1 1 ] ' || rec.c1 ||' '||rec.c2);

  fetch cur into rec;

  dbms_output.put_line('[预期 1 2 ] ' || rec.c1 ||' '||rec.c2);

  close cur;

end;

/

3、

set serveroutput on;

drop table if exists tb_static_cursor_03;

create table tb_static_cursor_03(id int,name varchar(200));

insert into tb_static_cursor_03 values(1,'may');

insert into tb_static_cursor_03 values(2,'spring');

insert into tb_static_cursor_03 values(3,'jack');

commit;



declare

	rec_var_01 tb_static_cursor_03%rowtype;

	CURSOR cur_01(name in int) is select id,name from tb_static_cursor_03 where id >name;

begin

	open cur_01(1);

	fetch cur_01 into rec_var_01;

	dbms_output.put_line(rec_var_01.id||','||rec_var_01.name);

	close cur_01;

end;

/

4、分布式

drop table if exists tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1;

create table tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1(tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_2 int, tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 varchar(10));

insert into tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 values(1, 'test1');

insert into tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 values(2, 'test2');

insert into tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 values(3, 'test3');

commit;



--匿名块局部变量

declare

  type type_001 is table of int;

  tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 type_001 := type_001(1, 2, 3);

begin

  forall i in tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1.first .. tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1.last

    update tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 set tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1.tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 = tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1.tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 * tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1(i) where tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1.tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1 = tb_YDBRD26361_forall_09_1(i);

  commit;

end;

/
